head.subject: feat(75): S75-T35 narrowed build - QC receipt adapter + binding instrument

landed_via.ancestry: git merge-base --is-ancestor de4a9a1d5d36989eedd8e4e7fd4ceb428f367c40 origin/main -> rc=0; the same check on a424e53e050a6a2471ffc65bbc3504c61f38ea38 -> rc=0

digest_basis: sha256 of each file as it stands on origin/main and as it stands at the landed candidate; for all five paths the two blobs are identical (git rev-parse <ref>:<path> compared), so the measured tree is the landed tree.
change_summary: Adds the fail-closed QC receipt adapter: a receipt confirms a unit only when it is a structured claim, names a full 40-hex head_tested equal to the candidate head, and its approver differs from the author on identity AND lineage (and, for kind=repair, its verifier differs from repair_author on both). Every refusal is a durable, acknowledged ledger row (wrong_head, head_not_full_sha, unstructured_stdout, missing_structured_claim, self_approved, repair_author_not_independent, no_checks_recorded, identity_or_lineage_missing, wrong_unit, verdict_not_confirmable) rather than an exception. Duplicate verdicts are byte-identical no-ops; a different verdict at the same unit+head is a conflict that the first verdict survives, resolvable only by a distinct third authority through one adjudication event. The narrowing also instruments the role-to-chain binding: workflow_of -> _meta_index -> served_route -> route_binding, persisted at start(), returning match / substitution / unverified_no_binding_record, fail-closed at head and fail-open at base.

narrowing.kept: Clauses 1, 2 and 4: the wrong-head / abbreviated-head / stdout-only / self-approved / repair-author-not-independent refusals, the idempotent duplicate handling, and the evidence-channel cell this file satisfies.
narrowing.left_the_row: Clause 3's binding-VALUE assertion (which chain builders, QC and repair ride). The arbiter ruled it contradicted by measured runs and by the repository's own role-to-chain default map, and its only source was the unit's own self-declaration.
narrowing.replacement_claim: The role-to-chain binding is instrumented and resolvable fail-closed from harness-written agent-*.meta.json records. The narrowed build asserts instrumentation and fail-closed resolution only, and does not assert which chain any role rides. evidence/qc-receipt-contract.json carries this as binding_instrument.narrowing and binding_instrument.explicitly_not_asserted.

tests_run.summary: checks run: 104; PASS: S75-T35 qc receipt adapter
Ran 20 tests in 2.705s; OK. Includes the binding-instrument witnesses that grade the instrument on neutral chain names.

known_good_control.statement: The adapter suite is a positive/negative pair, not a one-sided refusal: the same structured receipt that is refused for a wrong head, an abbreviated head, an unstructured payload, a self-approved approver or a repair-author verifier is CONFIRMED when head_tested is changed to the candidate head and the parties are genuinely distinct.
known_good_control.instrument_control: tests/unit/test_workflow_slots.py runs the binding instrument against neutral chain labels on purpose, so a green result grades fail-closed resolution and never restates a doctrine about who rides what; the negative direction (a fabricated workflow id) resolves to unverified_no_binding_record at head and to somebody else's route at base.

open_residuals_carried_not_closed.status: OPEN, measured once by round 2 (probe X5), not re-measured here
open_residuals_carried_not_closed.detail: Rejection rows carry no author/approver, so two different parties submitting the same rejection collapse to one row and the second returns outcome=duplicate. Site: CONTROL/qc_receipt_adapter.py _entry_key plus the rejections append at lines 404-420. This receipt does not claim it closed.

Nothing in the repository calls commit_verdict or the start() binding path in a production supervisor. Every clause-1 and clause-2 measurement, here and in the three rounds, is made at the adapter API.
The unit lands as one squashed commit per round, so no pre-fix version of either test file exists in the repository and earlier disclosed failures cannot be shown fixed rather than routed around.

closed_since_round_3.at_landed_candidate: CLOSED by this build: _apply_adjudication now merges parties from the recorded verdict, the conflict AND every recorded entry before the distinctness check, so a party present in any entry is refused. Diff 3d9969fcd..de4a9a1d5 on CONTROL/qc_receipt_adapter.py is +3/-1 at exactly that merge.
closed_since_round_3.not_reverified_independently: The lane reports the diff it read; an independent verifier should re-measure the probe.

most_important_sentence: A wrong-head, abbreviated-head, stdout-only or self-approved receipt never reaches QC_CONFIRMED, a duplicate verdict leaves the ledger byte-identical, and the binding instrument refuses to answer for a record that belongs to another workflow.
